environment.description: Same service deployed behind Envoy sidecar proxy (Istio 1.19) with AuthorizationPolicy that strips non-allowlisted metadata keys before forwarding to upstream gRPC services. The allowlist is defined in an EnvoyFilter resource matching route 'grpc-proxy-route' with a Lua filter that iterates request headers and removes any key matching pattern '^x-(internal|forwarded|mesh)-.*' before the request reaches the application. Additionally, the HTML responses are post-processed by a response header injection at the Envoy level that adds Content-Security-Policy with script-src directives requiring SRI hashes (sha384-oqVuAfXRKap7fdgcCY5uykM6+R9GqQ8K/uxy9rx7HNQlGYl1kPzQho1wx4JwY8wC) for all external script loads, and the CDN scripts are pinned with crossorigin='anonymous' and integrity attributes injected via an Envoy ext_proc filter that parses HTML responses and adds integrity attributes to known script sources from a hash manifest stored in a ConfigMap. The Lua metadata stripping filter runs at filter_chain priority 10 (before the application filter at priority 100), ensuring headers are sanitized regardless of application-level processing.

config.envoy_ext_proc: HTML response rewriting to inject SRI integrity attributes from ConfigMap hash manifest
config.csp_injection: script-src with sha384 hashes for known scripts, no unsafe-inline
config.authorization_policy: ALLOW only from ingress-gateway with principal cluster.local/ns/istio-system/sa/istio-ingressgateway
config.peer_authentication: STRICT mTLS for all workloads in namespace
